digest.component_or_area: usage_log pricing and model reference resolution
propositions: Provider-qualified model strings (e.g., 'anthropic:claude-opus-4-8', 'openai:gpt-5.4') passed to genai-prices.calc_price raise LookupError because genai-prices expects bare model ids without provider prefix.

LookupError is silently caught and converted to 'unpriced' status with no warning, causing Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows to drop from cost totals while Bedrock rows price successfully, creating asymmetric cost comparison bias.
The asymmetry makes provider cost comparisons misleading by showing only Bedrock with cost figures while Anthropic and OpenAI appear blank, despite all models being known to genai-prices.

Model id translation must be decided by registry membership in KNOWN_PROVIDER_NAMES rather than naive prefix-stripping, because Bedrock's AWS id format and versioned ids (e.g., 'anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0') require provider-aware handling.
The pricing best-effort policy must remain in place (pricing never breaks summarize), but genuinely unresolvable models must be distinguishable from mis-formatted ids in output.
